field.name: Name
field.transport.hint: Read only: it comes from the profile file.
field.auto_reconnect.hint: Try again by itself when the connection drops.
error.gui_profile_changed: This profile was changed somewhere else since you opened it.
issue.invalid_cidr: Use addresses with a prefix, like 10.8.0.2/32, separated by commas.
issue.invalid_ip: Use IP addresses separated by commas.
issue.invalid_key: A WireGuard key is 44 characters of base64 that end with =.
issue.invalid_domain: Use domain names separated by commas.
issue.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
issue.count_changed: The number of peers cannot change here.
issue.wrong_protocol: This change does not fit this kind of profile.
savebar.label: Unsaved changes
savebar.text: You have changes that are not saved.
leave.title: Save your changes?
leave.body: {name} has changes that are not saved.
changed.body: This profile was changed somewhere else, for example from the command line. Your edits are kept here until you reload; reloading shows the new version and drops them.
field.addresses.hint: With the prefix, separated by commas: 10.8.0.2/32.
field.mtu.hint: From 576 to 9000. Empty uses the default.
field.allowed_ips.hint: The networks that go through the tunnel, separated by commas.
field.ipv6_block.hint: Stops IPv6 traffic from going around the tunnel.
field.ignore_pushed_routes: Ignore the routes the server pushes
field.ignore_pushed_routes.hint: Keep only the routes of the profile.
net.full_tunnel: All traffic goes through the tunnel.
net.split_tunnel: Only the networks listed here go through the tunnel.
net.during_connection: DNS and routes in effect: available while connected.
auth.method.hint: Read only: it comes from the profile file.
auth.method.user_pass_otp: User name, password and a code
auth.private_key.stored: In the secrets store. It is never shown.
error.gui_group_invalid: This is not a valid group name.
error.gui_group_exists: A group with this name already exists.
error.gui_group_not_found: This group is no longer in the list.
groups.title: Manage groups
groups.description: The order here is the order of the list. A group is only a name: deleting one keeps its profiles.
groups.unlisted: In use by profiles but not in your list
groups.delete.title: Delete the group {name}?
groups.delete.body.one: 1 profile stays without a group. The profile itself is kept.
groups.delete.body.other: {count} profiles stay without a group. The profiles themselves are kept.
config.hint.openvpn: Saved exactly as you write it, comments included. Keys and certificate files do not go here: import the profile again to change them.
config.hint.wireguard: Read only. Every setting is in the other tabs. The keys are in the secrets store and are not shown.
config.issue.syntax: The text cannot be read: check the quotes and the closing tags.
config.issue.script: Galleria does not run the scripts of profiles.
config.issue.dangerous: Galleria does not allow this directive: it can run programs or change files on this computer.
config.issue.unsupported: Galleria does not support this directive.
config.issue.daemon_owned: The service sets this by itself. Remove the line.
config.issue.file_reference: Files are not read from here. Import the profile again to add certificates and keys.
config.issue.secret_block: Keys do not go in this text. Import the profile again to change them.
config.issue.no_tls_client: There is no client or tls-client line, so the profile may not connect. You can still save.
issue.config_issues: The configuration has problems that stop it from being saved. They are listed below the text.
config.secrets.none: No secrets are stored for this profile.
error.gui_profile_in_use: This profile is in use by a connection. Disconnect first.
error.gui_export_failed: The file could not be saved.
error.import_syntax: The profile has a syntax error.
error.import_missing_file: A file that the profile refers to cannot be read.
error.import_outside_folder: The profile refers to a file outside its folder.
error.import_invalid: This is not a valid VPN profile.
error.gui_import_too_large: The file or the text is too large (the limit is 1 MiB).
error.gui_import_unsupported_file: Only .ovpn and .conf files can be imported.
error.gui_import_expired: The preview has expired: choose the file again.
import.title: Import profile
import.description.source: Choose a file or paste the text of the profile. Nothing is saved until you choose Import.
import.description.preview: Check what will be saved. Nothing is written until you choose Import.
import.text.label: Paste the text of the profile
import.name: Name
import.found: Found: {names}. They will be saved in the secrets archive.
import.found.none: The profile has no keys or secrets in it.
import.auth.user_pass: The credentials will be asked at the first connection.
import.notice.script: Galleria does not run the scripts of profiles. If the profile depends on it, it may not work fully.
import.notice.script_dns: Galleria does not run the scripts of profiles. Galleria applies the DNS of the server itself.
import.notice.dangerous: Galleria does not allow it in profiles.
import.notice.no_client: The “client” line is missing: the profile may not be a client profile.
import.error.title: The profile was not imported
import.error.syntax_line: The profile cannot be read: there is an error at line {line}.
import.error.missing_file_text: The text refers to the file “{file}”, and pasted text has no folder to read it from. Import the file itself instead.
export.title: Export {name}?
export.body: The file will contain the private keys of this profile. Keep it somewhere safe.
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: The profile and its secrets are removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
